title: The fire nobody sees
odia: ବଣ ପୋଡ଼ିଲେ ଦୁନିଆ ଜାଣେ, ମନ ପୋଡ଼ିଲେ କେହୀ ନ ଜାଣେ
literal_meaning: When a forest burns, the world knows; when the heart burns, no one knows.
explanation: Visible calamity draws attention; private grief can remain unnoticed. The contrast asks the listener to recognise pain that has no outward blaze.
meaning_odia: ବାହାରର ବିପଦ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଦେଖାଯାଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ ମନର ଦୁଃଖ ଅନ୍ୟଙ୍କ ଅଗୋଚରରେ ରହିପାରେ।
usage_example: A neighbour appears composed at work while privately grieving a loss. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary places this under mental distress. “No one” is the saying’s emphatic contrast, not a claim that support is impossible.
